// Faux decision-model provider for the CLI subprocess tests.
//
// Loaded with `node --import` so the real composition root, its preconditions,
// and its adapters run unchanged — only the model call is faked. No network.
// Copied into the fixture repo by the test (never executed by the npm glob).
import { fauxAssistantMessage, getModel, registerFauxProvider } from "@earendil-works/pi-ai/compat";

const provider = process.env.FAUX_PROVIDER ?? "openai";
const modelId = process.env.FAUX_MODEL ?? "gpt-4";
const mode = process.env.FAUX_MODE ?? "good";

const model = getModel(provider, modelId);
const registration = registerFauxProvider({ api: model.api });

/** Concatenated text blocks of the transcript. */
function promptText(context) {
	const parts = [];
	for (const message of context?.messages ?? []) {
		if (!Array.isArray(message.content)) continue;
		for (const block of message.content) {
			if (block.type === "text" && typeof block.text === "string") parts.push(block.text);
		}
	}
	return parts.join("\n");
}

/** The judged slice, copied out of the prompt the adapter built. */
function sliceOf(prompt) {
	const marker = "## Test source";
	const after = prompt.slice(prompt.indexOf(marker) + marker.length);
	const open = after.indexOf("```ts\n");
	const body = after.slice(open + 6);
	return body.slice(0, body.indexOf("\n```"));
}

function startLineOf(prompt) {
	const match = prompt.match(/^Lines: (\d+)-(\d+)$/m);
	return match ? Number(match[1]) : 1;
}

function answer(context) {
	const prompt = promptText(context);
	if (mode === "pending") {
		return fauxAssistantMessage(
			JSON.stringify({ decision: "AMBIGUOUS", confidence: 0.3, criteria: [], reason: "", evidence: [] }),
		);
	}
	if (mode === "bad") {
		return fauxAssistantMessage(
			JSON.stringify({
				decision: "BAD",
				confidence: 0.95,
				criteria: ["C2"],
				reason: "the assertion only restates an input literal",
				evidence: [{ line: startLineOf(prompt), quote: sliceOf(prompt) }],
			}),
		);
	}
	return fauxAssistantMessage(
		JSON.stringify({
			decision: "GOOD",
			confidence: 0.92,
			criteria: ["C1", "C2"],
			reason: "asserts project-owned observable behaviour",
			evidence: [],
		}),
	);
}

registration.setResponses(Array.from({ length: 64 }, () => answer));
